detailed_descriptions.en: Crystal Breaker is a dynamic incremental game about flying through crystal planet, destroying crystal formations, and constantly upgrading your ship. Some crystals are easy to break, while others explode or require much greater firepower to destroy. As you progress, you will upgrade your main weapon to break through crystal masses faster, unlock new resources, and earn more efficiently. Crystal Breaker is a game about constant growth, satisfying destruction, discovering new crystal types, and building an increasingly powerful space mining ship.

Crystal Breaker is a dynamic incremental game about flying through crystal planet, destroying crystal formations, and constantly upgrading your ship. Some crystals are easy to break, while others explode or require much greater firepower to destroy.

As you progress, you will upgrade your main weapon to break through crystal masses faster, unlock new resources, and earn more efficiently.

Crystal Breaker is a game about constant growth, satisfying destruction, discovering new crystal types, and building an increasingly powerful space mining ship.
